text: Limen [Lat.]: equivalent to THRESHOLD (q.v.), which is already current, and is preferred. The adjectives 'liminal' (at the threshold), 'subliminal' (below the threshold), and 'supraliminal' (above the threshold) are useful. Cf. LIMITS OF STIMULATION. ( J.M.B. )
